title: Certify the V4 v1 candidate
goal: Produce real Linux complete and Windows full certification evidence, freeze compatibility and recovery authorities, and prove the full V1 acceptance boundary without release publication or activation.
acceptanceCriteria: A platform-native runner produces schema-valid hash-bound reports from real Linux and Windows executions and refuses platform mismatch.
One clean external synthetic project completes Bootstrap, Analysis, Pre and Post followed by accepted factory reset without PackageRoot or TargetRoot mutation.
Supply-chain validation covers dependency locks, offline restore policy, exact package/archive contents and the absence of IFX, V3 or LayerGuard runtime paths.
Stable CLI, configuration and report authorities are frozen in an exact compatibility baseline and a generated recovery artifact binds the P7 restore seed.
The v1 record remains a local candidate with releaseAuthorized, activeIfxCutover and ifxProfileIncluded all false.
No release, tag, active workflow, ruleset, push, remote mutation or IFX cutover occurs.
